The price of **Bitcoin (BTC)** fluctuates constantly due to market demand. As of **June 2024**, the approximate price is:

- **~$65,000 – $70,000 USD** (varies by exchange and time of day).

For the **most up-to-date price**, check live cryptocurrency platforms like:
- [CoinMarketCap](https://coinmarketcap.com/)
- [CoinGecko](https://www.coingecko.com/)
- [Binance](https://www.binance.com/)
- [Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com/)

Would you like help tracking trends or understanding Bitcoin's price movements?
